svg.aria-label: Ecosystem map: synthwerk (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk). One repo per role. Start there. Blueprint: Shared CI, lint configs and templates: synthwerk-blueprint (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk-blueprint). Renamed: This repo was renamed. The old URL still redirects here. Legacy code: The tag legacy-final keeps the old service: a Kotlin/Quarkus prototype with hard-coded users and no tokens. Branching: When the code returns: main deploys to dev, a vX.Y.Z tag to stg, an approved digest to prd. License: MIT. Copyright 2025 Velimir Müller
